title: Mandatory-chain stage segment summary (WI-380)
description: The schema-forced return a fresh per-stage subagent hands back to the orchestrator. The orchestrator holds ONLY these summaries + the receipts index — never the stage's full working context. Capped small (~1K tokens) so the orchestrator context stays flat across a full delivery.

receipt_sha.description: the commit SHA whose receipts THIS stage's own shell emitted (orchestration verifies, never re-emits — AC3)

receipts_emitted.description: receipt types this stage emitted (e.g. plan-manifest, review-plan)

baton_read.description: the hash-bound baton (plan-manifest.ac_digests) this stage read — NEVER a prose summary of the prior stage (AC4)

summary.description: ≤~1K tokens: what the stage did + what the next stage needs. Prose for humans; the orchestrator routes on next_action + receipts, not this.

next_action.description: the kickback-ladder outcome (scripts/stage-segment.mjs nextStageAction) — explicit backward control flow (AC2)
